'''Talon Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|Company]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. It was lead by a [[General/Legends|General]] named [[Narell Balrekk]] who had a great deal of military experience. The [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]] was extremely important to Talon Company because the possibility of capturing someone aligned with [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] would mean that the company would get recognized by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[Darth Sidious|Emperor]].<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talon Company is also the name of a Mercenary organization in Fallout.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
